jsonld.name: True Glow Esthetics
jsonld.description: Boutique esthetics studio in Hollywood, FL specializing in custom facials and sugar waxing with esthetician Emily, inside Phenix Salon Suites.

parrafo.es: Emily es la esteticista detrás de True Glow, dedicada a realzar tu belleza natural y tu confianza con una selección de servicios de spa en un suite privado. Especializada en faciales y sugaring, sabe exactamente cómo hacerte sentir cómoda y renovada.
parrafo.en: Emily is the esthetician behind True Glow, dedicated to enhancing your natural beauty and boosting your confidence with a curated range of spa services in a private suite. Specializing in facials and sugar waxing, she knows exactly how to make you feel comfortable and renewed.

hero.imagen_alt: Treatment room at True Glow Esthetics with warm lighting and the studio's glowing sign

parrafo_1.es: True Glow Esthetics es el estudio de Emily dentro de Phenix Salon Suites en Hollywood Blvd. Ahí recibe a cada clienta en un suite privado, sin salas compartidas ni prisas, para faciales personalizados y sugaring de cuerpo completo.
parrafo_1.en: True Glow Esthetics is Emily's studio inside Phenix Salon Suites on Hollywood Blvd. Every client is seen in a private suite, no shared rooms and no rush, for custom facials and full-body sugar waxing.

parrafo_2.es: Las 40 reseñas de 5 estrellas en Booksy repiten lo mismo: paciencia, cuidado y un trato que hace que las clientas vuelvan cita tras cita, algunas desde hace casi dos años.
parrafo_2.en: The 40 five-star reviews on Booksy all say the same thing: patience, care, and a touch that keeps clients coming back appointment after appointment, some for almost two years now.

items.quote: Services with Emily are therapeutic for me. I fall asleep on the table and let her do her magic. We're locked in for almost 2 years now.

Waxing with Emily has literally changed my life. I feel so clean and relaxed when I come to do my wax. I was always a person who shaved and didn't see the need for wax but after my first time, I realized how important it is to wax. It leaves me feeling so much more confident and secure about myself.
Emily was great! It was my first ever getting any type of wax so I was very nervous. She was very patient and sweet with me. Definitely recommend going to her!!
